name: Pawabase Studio Design System
description: The visual system of the Studio control plane. Calm and rounded: an off-white canvas framed by a slightly deeper lilac, white cards with large soft corners and no borders, pill buttons (ink filled for the primary action), and a pastel palette for decoration rather than state.
principles: Calm and rounded — big radii, borderless white cards floating on a tinted canvas, no hard edges.
Ink is the primary action — primary buttons fill with ink, not brand purple. Brand color is an accent for focus, links and selection.
Pastels are decoration only — lavender, peach, mint, butter, sky and rose never mean anything; if a color carries state, it is a status color.
Status colors are semantic only — ok, warn, danger and info always mean a state and are never used decoratively.
Pastel fills always carry dark ink text, in either theme.
Two themes, one token set — every color is a CSS variable; dark mode swaps values, never structure.
Everything pill-shaped that is an action; radii soften as surfaces get bigger (sm 12 → xl 30).
Motion is quiet and short (0.1–0.3s); honor prefers-reduced-motion.

usage_rules.frame: The deepest layer — the page background around every surface.
usage_rules.canvas: The main content area inside the frame; cards float on it.
usage_rules.surface: Cards, sidebar, inputs, popovers — anything that raises.
usage_rules.sunken: Recessed wells: segmented tracks, code blocks, switcher, summary bars.
usage_rules.line: Hairline separators inside cards and tables.
usage_rules.line2: Input borders, default button borders, dashed add-rows.
usage_rules.ink: Primary text and primary button fill; toasts are ink pills.
usage_rules.brand: Focus rings, active edges, links, selection; never a large fill except soft.
usage_rules.pastel: Nav-active, tiles, sidebar cards, HTTP method chips, login art. Always with pastelInk text.
usage_rules.status: Badges, alerts, lights, deltas, error text. Pair solid (text/icon) with soft (background).

patterns.cardLift: translateY(-2px) + shadow on hover (link cards only)
patterns.riseStagger: rise animation with --i * 60ms delay per item
patterns.blink: opacity pulse to 0.35 at 50% for down/pending lights

motion.reduced_motion: All animation and transition durations collapse to 0.01ms under prefers-reduced-motion.

notes.980: Sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer; flow editor hides palette/inspector; form grids collapse to one column.
notes.560: KPI grid drops to 2 narrow; breadcrumbs hidden.

iconography.style: Inline stroke SVGs (24px viewBox), stroke-width 2, round caps/joins, currentColor.

button.shape: pill (radius 99), inline-flex, gap 7, padding 8x16, weight 600, size 13.5

primary.note: Ink, not brand — the primary action is monochrome

alert.pairing: solid for text on soft background

card.flush: padding 0, overflow hidden; header rows separated by line

tile.tileIcon: 38x38, radius 12, translucent white 0.55 backdrop, pastelInk icon

input.shape: radius sm, border line2, padding 9x12, size 13.5, background surface
input.labelField: stacked label 12.5/600 with optional marker; hint 12 muted below; error-text 12.5 danger
input.inputGroup: attached segments, shared sm radius on ends, addon well sunken
input.select: native, custom chevron 16px at right 10, padding-right 32
input.textarea: mono 12.5, vertical resize, min-height 100; .prose variant sans 13.5

tabs.shape: sunken pill track, 4px padding, items 13/600 pill

segmented: same anatomy as tabs, size 12.5, padding 3px track

codeBlock: sunken well, radius sm, padding 12x14, max-height 420, scroll

sheet.head: tile-icon 44x44 radius 14 + title 19 + sub 12.5 muted
sheet.body: canvas background, scroll, sections are form-section cards
sheet.foot: surface bar with top line, action row

toast.shape: ink pill, onInk text, 13.5/550, shadow pop, pop animation

navItem.active: lavender fill + pastelInk 650 — a pastel, because navigation identity is decoration, not state

switcher: sunken well radius md, 34px avatar, hover line; invisible native select overlay

sidebarCard: pastel (default peach), radius lg, ink CTA button inside

avatar.initials: grid-centered 800 14, lavender default, mint circle variant

lights.dot: 8px: up ok + 18% halo, down danger + 22% halo + blink, unknown line2, pending line2 + blink
lights.popover: 270px surface card radius md shadow pop

commandPalette.trigger: 240px pill expanding to 320 on focus, kbd chip sunken 11/600
commandPalette.results: 360px surface dropdown radius md, groups as eyebrows, item 13.5 radius 10, active brandSoft
commandPalette.icon: 28x28 sunken radius 8; active swaps to surface/brandStrong

flowNode.shape: surface card radius 14, 170–240 wide, line2 border
flowNode.handles: 10px brand dots with surface border; error handle danger
flowNode.canvas: canvas background, line2 dots, edges line2 1.8 → brand when selected

paletteItem: sunken well radius sm 12.5/600; hover brand border + brandSoft

chart.series: brand for emphasis, lavender for bars, chartMint for positive-only series
chart.tooltip: ink card radius 12, onInk 12, pointer-events none

kpi.label: 12.5/600 muted
kpi.delta: pill 11.5/700 — good ok pair, bad danger pair
kpi.liveDot: 8px ok with 20% halo; busy variant brand + blink 0.9s

login.layout: two columns 1.05fr/1fr inside frame, art panel lavender with blobs, form panel canvas with 400px card

theming.mechanism: CSS custom properties on :root; dark via prefers-color-scheme plus manual data-theme override (data-theme=light wins, data-theme=dark forces)
theming.colorScheme: light and dark values declared for native controls and scrollbars
theming.scrollbar: thin, line2 thumb on transparent track

layout.shell: Frame padding 14 with sidebar (272, radius xl) and main canvas (radius xl) side by side; main scrolls internally.
layout.topbar: Sticky, canvas at 88% opacity + 10px blur, breadcrumbs as pills on the left, status lights + command palette + icon actions on the right.
layout.content: Max 1320 centered, 32px side padding; .full variant for edge-to-edge tools like the flow editor.
